docs.title: What's Efflux
docs.text:
Efflux is an advanced, lightweight, and flexible framework designed for buiding your AI agents and interacting with multiple MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. It seamlessly integrates with various AI-powered LLMs (large language models), enabling efficient data streaming and dynamic tool loading. With its modular architecture and user-friendly interface, Efflux simplifies the deployment and scaling of AI-driven applications.

In a nutshell, Efflux servers as:

  • an out-of-box chatbot featuring code generation.

  • an out-of-box MCP (Model Context Protocol) host to connect with your MCP servers, such as databases and functions, enabling standardized tool invocation and data access for large language models.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
The key features that Efflux offers include:

  • Rapid agent construction

  • Dynamic MCP tool loading and invocation

  • Support for multiple large language models

  • Real-time streaming chat responses

  • Chat history management

  • Dark/Light theme support

docs.title: How to Get Involved
docs.text: We welcome contributions! Here's how you can get involved:

docs.title: Commit Changes
docs.text:
1. Fork the repository.
  2. Create a new branch (git checkout -b feature-branch).
  3. Make your changes.
  4. Commit your changes (git commit -am 'Add new feature').
  5. Push to your branch (git push origin feature-branch).
  6. Open a pull request.

Make sure you follow the coding standards and guidelines defined in the project. See the Contributing Guidelines for more details.

docs.title: Report Issues
docs.text:
If you encounter any issues or bugs, feel free to open an issue in the respective repository.

Be sure to include:

  • A description of the issue.
  • Steps to reproduce (if applicable).
  • Logs or screenshots that can help in debugging.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text: Make sure you have Python 3.12 or higher versions installed and set up the efflux backend service.

docs.title: 1. Clone the Repository
docs.text:
In your terminal:

git clone https://github.com/isoftstone-data-intelligence-ai/efflux-frontend.git

docs.title: 2. Install the Dependencies
docs.text:
Enter the repository:

cd efflux-frontend

Run the following to install the required dependencies:

npm i

docs.title: 3. Set the Environment Variables
docs.text:
Create a .env.local file and set the following:

# Get your API key here - https://e2b.dev/
E2B_API_KEY="your-e2b-api-key"

# Get your Azure API key here https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/create-resource?tabs=portal
AZURE_API_KEY="your-azure-api-key"

# API URL
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL="your-backend-service-url"

# OpenAI API Key
OPENAI_API_KEY=

# Other providers
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=
GROQ_API_KEY=
FIREWORKS_API_KEY=
TOGETHER_API_KEY=
GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY=
GOOGLE_VERTEX_CREDENTIALS=
MISTRAL_API_KEY=
XAI_API_KEY=

### Optional env vars

# Domain of the site
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=

# Disabling API key and base URL input in the chat
NEXT_PUBLIC_NO_API_KEY_INPUT=
NEXT_PUBLIC_NO_BASE_URL_INPUT=

# Rate limit
RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS=
RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW=

# Vercel/Upstash KV (short URLs, rate limiting)
KV_REST_API_URL=
KV_REST_API_TOKEN=

# Supabase (auth)
SUPABASE_URL=
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=

# PostHog (analytics)
NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY=
NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST=

npm run dev

docs.title: EFFLUX - 智能流式交互客户端
docs.text: 下一代AI交互平台，融合多模型协议与生成式前端技术，实现智能交互的全新范式。

docs.title: ✨ 核心特性
docs.text:
• 全协议支持
  • MCP协议原生支持（Model Context Protocol）
  • 兼容OpenAI API规范

  • 自定义协议适配器系统

  • 生成式前端

  • Artifacts动态渲染引擎
  • 支持Markdown/LaTeX/图表实时生成

  • 交互式代码沙箱

  • 混合架构

  • 多后端支持（DeepSeek/GLM/Claude等）
  • Agent路由管理系统

  • 多MCP Server并行接入

  • 智能扩展

  • 插件市场支持
  • 工作流编排引擎
  • 上下文记忆管理

docs.title: 🧩 技术架构
docs.text:
EFFLUX
├── Core
│   ├── MCP Adapter       # 协议转换层
│   ├── Model Router      # 智能路由
│   └── Context Manager   # 对话上下文管理
├── Artifacts Engine      # 动态前端渲染
├── Service Layer
│   ├── LLM Services      # 多模型接入
│   └── Agent Gateway     # Agent服务网关
├── Plugin System         # 扩展模块
└── Web Interface         # 交互式前端

docs.title: 环境要求
docs.text:
• Node.js 18+
  • Python 3.10+ (可选)
  • Docker (推荐)

docs.title: 安装步骤
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/yourname/efflux.git
cd efflux

# 安装依赖
npm install

# 配置环境变量
cp .env.example .env

# 启动开发环境
npm run dev

docs.title: 🌟 核心功能演示
docs.text:
// 多模型协同示例
const efflux = new EFFLUX({
  providers: [
    { type: 'deepseek', apiKey: 'YOUR_KEY' },
    { type: 'mcp-server', endpoint: 'your.mcp.server' }
  ]
});

const response = await efflux.generate({
  prompt: "请分析这份销售数据：",
  artifacts: {
    data: salesData, // 自动生成可视化图表
    render: 'chart' 
  },
  context: {
    strategy: 'multi-agent',
    workflow: 'data-analysis'
  }
});

docs.title: 🔧 插件开发
docs.text:
创建自定义插件模板：

// plugins/custom-plugin.js
export default {
  name: 'my-plugin',
  hooks: {
    preProcess: (input) => {
      // 自定义预处理逻辑
      return enhancedInput;
    }
  }
}

docs.title: 🌍 生态集成
docs.text:
支持多种扩展方式：

integrations:
  - type: mcp-server
    endpoints:
      - url: api.your-mcp.com
        version: 2.1
  - type: llm-service
    providers:
      - name: Deepseek-v2
        api_type: cloud
  - type: artifact
    components:
      - 3d-visualizer

docs.title: 🤝 贡献指南
docs.text:
欢迎通过以下方式参与贡献： 1. 提交Issue报告问题 2. 发起Pull Request改进代码 3. 参与插件生态建设 4. 完善文档翻译

请阅读Contribute to Efflux获取详细指引。

docs.title: 📄 许可协议
docs.text:
本项目基于 MIT License

项目进化路线

  • [ ] Phase 1: 核心协议支持（Q3 2024）
  • [ ] Phase 2: 分布式Agent网络（Q4 2024）
  • [ ] Phase 3: 自主进化架构（2025）

提示：推荐使用Docker部署MCP协议网关以获得最佳性能。

设计方案特点： 1. 采用分层架构设计，保持核心协议层与业务逻辑解耦 2. 动态前端渲染引擎支持复杂交互场景 3. 智能路由系统可根据上下文自动选择最优模型组合 4. 插件系统采用WebAssembly实现安全隔离 5. 内置多协议转换网关，兼容现有AI生态系统

建议后续开发重点： 1. 实现MCP协议的核心编解码模块 2. 构建Artifacts组件库 3. 开发模型路由的QoS评估系统 4. 设计插件沙箱安全机制 5. 实现上下文记忆的向量化存储

需要特别注意： - 协议层的安全性设计 - 多模型协同时的上下文一致性 - 生成式前端的XSS防护 - 大流量下的资源调度策略
